issues.where: the collar where the glass meets the base
issues.what: the snow shelf is taller and puffier than the low crystalline ring, and the glass ends on a hard dark line with a gap instead of seating into the snow
issues.fix: thin the snow to a low even shelf that leaves the metal lip showing, and seat the sphere so the joint is a soft shadow rather than a gap

issues.where: the collar where the glass meets the base
issues.what: the snow on the collar is thicker and more bulbous, and the glass sits on a hard dark boundary instead of merging into the snow
issues.fix: lower and thin the collar snow to the uneven crystalline shelf, and seat the sphere behind that lip

issues.where: the rope trim and the relief highlights
issues.what: the brightest metal reads pale brass, about [216, 191, 164], against the deeper antique bronze of the target, about [217, 176, 131]
issues.fix: darken and redden the rope and the leaf highlights so they age back to antique bronze

issues.where: the rope trim and the relief highlights
issues.what: the same paler, less aged brass on the rope and the leaf edges, against the warmer antique bronze of the target
issues.fix: shift the trim and the relief highlights down and toward antique bronze

issues.what: the icicles are thicker, blunter, and smoother, without the slender glassy taper of the target
issues.fix: narrow the icicles, sharpen the tips, and put the internal refraction back; keep the fringe, do not restyle it as plastic cones

issues.what: the icicles are again thicker and rounder at the tips than the thin pointed fringe
issues.fix: thin and sharpen the icicles to the glassy taper of the target

issues.where: the surface around the foot, and its mirror image
issues.what: the frost is clumpy and granular instead of flat dendritic crystals, and the reflection of the rope and the icicle tips is duller
issues.fix: replace the clumps with flat dendritic ice and raise the contrast of the mirror under the foot

issues.where: the surface around the foot, and its mirror image
issues.what: the table frost is clumpier and less crystalline, and the mirror of the foot is weaker
issues.fix: lay flat dendritic crystals on the table and sharpen the reflection of the rope and the icicle tips

issues.where: the frost on the glass at the shoulder
issues.what: the rim thickness matches, but the frost is separate fronds with bare gaps instead of the continuous dense crystalline band
issues.fix: fill the shoulder frost into a continuous dense band; do not leave clear gaps between clusters

issues.where: the frost on the glass at the shoulder and the flanks
issues.what: frost is present but fainter and smoother, and it covers less of the rim than the sharp dendritic fringe
issues.fix: strengthen the frost on the glass edges to the sharp, opaque dendritic fringe

issues.where: the tree crown and the star
issues.what: the snow on the boughs is broken into round puffy pads instead of broad flat blankets, and the star is a soft bloom without the thin stem
issues.fix: flatten the snow into broad pads and set a crisp faceted star on a thin stem

issues.what: the stones read darker and rounder, with heavier joints, against the paler coursed blocks
issues.fix: lighten the wall and use flatter coursed stone

issues.what: the lantern cap is a smoother dome instead of the peaked cap
